name: Black / white Marble Shade Self Adhesive Roll Sheet Sticker For Kitchen, Cupboard, Wall – Anti Oil And Heat Resistant Wallpaper
description:
Product Details:
Marble Print PVC material, for kitchens. self-adhesive with resin without additional glue. The peel-off adhesive backing paper can be pasted and easily re positioned and removed. Thick wear layer to withstand daily wear and tear.





 	Waterproof, oil-resistant, stain-resistant and very easy to clean.
 	It is definitely the best choice for your DIY wall.
 	The marble Print pattern has been carefully designed for easy splicing.
 	Marble Print Sticker for smooth and flat surfaces.
 	Desks, kitchen countertops, furniture, dressing tables, drawers, crafts, bedside tables, bookcases, doors, laptops, cell phones, can also cover stains on the surface, a small change can bring great happiness.
 	Marble Sticker Sheet Clean the wall when using it and make sure it is dry.
 	If you have a large demand, please buy it at one time to prevent chromatic aberration.
 	Please do not let it directly contact the fire source.

When using it in the corners, use a hairdryer to make it stronger.


 	Self sticking, very easy to apply
 	Beautiful marble style texture
 	Can be applied on kitchen counter, cabinets, shelves and bathroom
size 60 x 200 cm
